schedule.step: Recruit two or three households, agree dates, send release pack
Collect signed or recorded releases (adults, guardians for children), file with sha256
Session A: indoor and window light (S01, S07, S10, S12, S16, S18)
Session B: bright daylight outdoors (S02, S05, S06, S11, S15, S19)
Session C: golden hour, backlit (S03, S09, S14, S17)
Session D: evening low light (S04, S08, S13, S20)
Cull, upright, strip metadata, name files by shot id
Run validate_photos.py, fix findings, reshoot any failed shot (allowance)
Rights review of manifest and releases, commit with CC0 dedication
